description: Connect PaceBeats to see today’s training, review your current or next week, and understand the recorded rationale behind your sessions. Explore your season plan, race calendar, recent training history, training preferences, and device connection status. You can also ask questions about PaceBeats features and settings. This connection provides read-only access: it does not create or change workouts, prescribe medical advice, or expose raw activity, heart-rate, power, route, or wellness data. A PaceBeats account is required for personal training information.

defaultPrompt: What training do I have planned today?
Show me my training plan for next week.
